name: Industry intelligence
blurb: Signals, patterns and insights about an industry, linked to the products and technologies they concern, with hybrid search over the sources.
about: A living market intelligence record for one industry, where each signal is filed for or against the beliefs it bears on, so you know when the evidence turns. Each signal is linked to the products, companies and source it concerns, so a belief is weighed on both sides and a contradiction shows up the day it is filed. Agents file what comes in and flag what is stale or contested, on branches an analyst reviews.
sample: The AI infrastructure market, from public sources
